dedupe_keys.name: wood mackenzie lens energy power and renewables upstream gas and lng and metals and mining data and analytics

description: Wood Mackenzie sells data, analytics and research on the energy and natural resources industries, delivered mainly through its Lens platform, and says it has more than 2,600 market experts, data scientists and analysts. Coverage: global, across the energy transition supply chain; Lens Power and Renewables covers power market fundamentals for the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa and Asia Pacific (80+ regions covering 98 percent of Asia Pacific power demand), with modules for wind, solar and energy storage and data on generation, demand and wholesale prices; other Lens products cover upstream oil and gas assets and valuations, subsurface, carbon management and emissions, energy transition scenarios, hydrogen, gas and LNG assets, market forecasts and modelling, and metals and mining assets, valuations, market forecasts, scenarios and supply chains; there are also commodity, power trading and supply chain analytics and consulting services. Format and access: the Lens web platform with an AI Insight Assistant, and Lens Direct for integrating the data into clients' own systems; demos on request. Licence: commercial subscription terms, not read. Caveats: prices, the fields of each asset database and historical depth were not read; figures are the vendor's. Simulation uses: power plant and asset data, market fundamentals and scenarios for capacity planning, energy system optimisation and supply chain studies of critical minerals. Related records: Rystad Energy (data-rystad-energy-asset-level-energy-databases), GlobalData (data-globaldata-power-oil-gas-construction-project-databases) and BloombergNEF (data-bloombergnef-energy-transition-research-and-data).
